'''Kadriss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]], Kadriss was stationed on [[Voss]], where he asked an Imperial to destroy [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] cyberbeasts after those wiped out the entirety of [[Bravo Team (Voss)|Bravo Team]].
